verdict: Spend of $7,221 produced only 2 leads this period; the main campaign is paused and conversions have collapsed.
diagnosis: Cost per lead landed near $3,610 — roughly 25x the health and wellness benchmark — because the call campaign is paused and purchases stalled.

signals.headline: Only 2 leads from $7,221 spend
signals.detail: Lead volume is near zero this period. The pipeline cannot sustain itself at this cost per lead.

signals.headline: Main search campaign is paused
signals.detail: The 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' is paused. That explains the collapse in impressions and clicks in recent days.

signals.headline: 9 purchases worth $5,897 recorded
signals.detail: Return on ad spend sits near $0.82 per dollar. Revenue is not covering media cost this period.

signals.headline: Only 1 call click in 28 days
signals.detail: For a call-focused medical alert business, this is the most alarming number in the report.

signals.headline: 163 direction requests on Google profile
signals.detail: Local interest exists. The business profile is generating meaningful intent that paid media is not capturing.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Health and wellness cost per lead
benchmark.body: Health and wellness consumer leads average around $98 to $142. Google search leads for medical categories typically run $30 to $150. Current spend produces leads far above both ranges.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Fall is a strong window for seniors
seasonal.body: Open enrollment and holiday family conversations drive medical alert interest in October and November. Adult children often research devices for aging parents during this window.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.body: The home medical alert market reached $4.93 billion in 2026, growing 11.9% from 2025. Bay Alarm, Lifeline, Life Alert, and Medical Guardian lead on fall detection and GPS features.

recommendations.title: Relaunch the paused call campaign with tight budget caps
recommendations.detail: Consider restarting the search call campaign with a daily cap and conversion tracking on phone calls. The current pause is the single biggest reason leads stopped.

recommendations.title: Shift budget toward call clicks, not clicks
recommendations.detail: Test call-only ads on mobile for 'life alert' and related terms. For this audience, a phone call is worth far more than a website click.

recommendations.title: Capture Google Business Profile demand
recommendations.detail: 163 direction requests this period shows local intent. Worth exploring call extensions, updated hours, and review requests to convert that interest into bookings.
